cover.alt: Venus Williams in a deep burgundy athletic set and red sneakers holds open the massive jaws of an oversized sculptural green crocodile with one arm raised, one foot planted on its red tongue — bold, athletic, and larger-than-life against a clean white background. Tagline: LACOSTE · PLAY BIG.

Rihanna stands centred against a deep blood-red backdrop, flanked by models Alton Mason and Omar Sesay in tailored black suits. She wears a sweeping floor-length white trench coat open over a minimal white string bikini, paired with thigh-high white leather boots, and holds a tall white cane. Her hair is a slicked, jet-black pixie-mullet, lips painted matte red. Mason holds an oversized white dome umbrella above her; Sesay carries a black briefcase. The mood is monumental, regal, and pristine — pure power dressing flipped into editorial drama. The bold black "DAZED" logotype dominates the top, with "The Reign Never Stops" stacked at right and "30th Anniversary Issue" running vertically.
Balmain fragrance campaign: a model poses with an oversized bronze perfume bottle against a vivid green background and a ring of fire.
